cues: In Group three A, ammonium chloride keeps hydroxide low, so iron, aluminium and chromium hydroxides precipitate while magnesium hydroxide stays dissolved.
And adding hydrogen chloride gas to brine, or common salt to soap, throws out pure sodium chloride or soap by the same principle.
